source: 663 Late Night
target: 663 Tarda Nocte

source: Like many cathedrals in Intis, Tizamo’s had a golden dome, resembling the sun’s reflection on the ground.
target: Sicut multa cathedralia in Intis, Tizamo habebat cupulam auream, quae reflexionem solis in terra imitabatur.

source: As Lumian passed through the door, he was dazzled by the walls, arches, gold leaf inlaid in the dome, a mural sprinkled with golden powder, and a golden statue.
target: Cum Lumian per ostium transiret, miratus est muris, arcubus, lamina aurea in cupula insertis, pictura muralis pulvere aureo sparso, atque statua aurea.

source: The sunlight streaming through the glass behind the altar made him instinctively raise his hand, wanting to press down his golden straw hat.
target: Lumen solis per vitrum post altare effluens eum incitavit ut manum attolleret, cupiens galeam stramineam auream suam premeret.

source: It was lunchtime, and many simply-dressed Tizamo residents sat in various pews, heads bowed in prayer.
target: Hora prandi erat, et multi incolae Tizamo, simpliciter vestiti, in variis sedibus consedebant, capita in oratione inclinata.

source: They didn’t mind the cathedral’s dazzling, extravagant appearance at all.
target: Aspectum effulgentem et extravagantem cathedralis omnino non curabant.

source: This was not only because they had always believed in the Eternal Blazing Sun since childhood, but they also had numerous gold mines in the former Balam Empire.
target: Non solum quod ex pueritia in Aeternum Ardentem Solem semper crediderunt, sed etiam multas fodinas auri in olim Imperio Balam habuerunt.

source: The people had a widespread fondness for gold, a hobby preserved to this day.
target: Populus late amorem pro auro habebat, studium quod usque hodie conservatum est.

source: Lumian shared an affinity for gold, but didn’t want to endure the scorching sunlight.
target: Lumian affinitatem pro auro habebat, sed solem ardentem non tolerare volebat.

source: Beside him, Camus tried explaining, “I’m not monitoring you, nor am I saying I’ll follow you everywhere to prevent accidents.
target: Prope eum, Camus experiebatur explanare: “Non te observo, neque dico me ubique te sequenturum esse ad casus vitandos.

source: “I’m assisting you. You’re still unfamiliar with Dutanese. You lack sufficient understanding of the situation in Tizamo and the people here. I can introduce you.”
target: “Te adiuvō. Dutanice adhuc ignotus es. Non satis intellegis de condicione Tizamo atque de his hominibus; te introducere possum.”

source: Lumian seized the opportunity to turn and ask with a smile, “Do you know it well?”
target: Lumian occasionem rapuit ut se converteret et sub risu quaereret: “Idne bene nosti?”

source: Camus ruffled his disheveled brown hair and replied without embarrassment, “If there’s anything I don’t understand, I can ask Maslow and the others to help.”
target: Camus capillos suos fuscos inordinatos concussit et sine pudore respondit: “Si quid nesciam, Maslow et ceteros rogare possum ut me adiuvent.”

source: Lumian didn’t mind having an official Beyonder by his side.
target: Lumian officialem Beyonder ad latus suum habere non curabat.

source: If anything happened, he could use the extra muscle.
target: Si quid eveniret, vires additas adhibere posset.

source: He nodded slightly and said, “If you want to follow, go ahead.”
target: Levis annuens dixit: “Si sequi velis, age.”

source: As Lumian spoke, he walked towards the row of seats in front of the altar under the blazing sunlight.
target: Dum Lumian loquebatur, ambulavit versus ordinem sedium ante altare sub sole ardente.

source: Camus hesitated for a few seconds before finding a seat in the farthest corner of the cathedral.
target: Camus paucis momentis vacillavit, deinde sedem in angulo remotissimo cathedralis invenit.

source: As a believer of Earth Mother, he could freely enter and exit the cathedrals of all orthodox gods, but he couldn’t participate in acts of worship.
target: Ut fidelis Matris Terrae, libere in cathedralia omnium diorum orthodoxorum intrare et exire poterat, sed in ritibus cultus participare non poterat.

source: He only knew that Louis Berry had a close connection to the Church of The Fool, but he wasn’t sure if his faith was with The Fool.
target: Sciebat solum Louis Berry nexum intimum habere cum Ecclesia Stulti, sed non certe an fides eius ad Stultum pertineat.

source: Lumian used his Ascetic endurance to control the twitching of his facial muscles.
target: Lumian tolerantiam asceticam adhibuit ut tremorem musculorum faciei temperaret.

source: He sat down under the sunlight as if nothing happened and lowered his head to pray in front of the preaching padre.
target: Sub sole sedebat quasi nihil accidisset et caput inclinavit ut coram praedicante padre oraret.

source: The padre, a native of Port Pylos named Cali, had standard dark brown skin, sunken eyes, and a chiseled face.
target: Padre, nativo Portus Pylos nomine Cali, cutem fuscam consuetam, oculos demissos et faciem sculptam habebat.

source: He only had a thin layer of black hair, not wearing a clergyman’s hat.
target: Habebat tantum tenue stratum capillorum nigrorum, nec petasum sacerdotale gestabat.

source: In his forties with a solemn expression, he preached in unaccented Intisian.
target: In annis quadragenariis, vultu solenne, in lingua Intisiana, sine accentu praedicabat.

source: Lumian, feigning prayer, found himself distracted.
target: Lumian, orationem simulans, se distrahisse sensit.

source: Thoughts raced through his mind, making him feel as if he had returned to Cordu.
target: Cogitationes per mentem eius festinanter currebant, facientes ut se quasi ad Cordum rediret.

source: Back then, even when attending Mass and praying in the cathedral, he was lost in his own thoughts.
target: Illo tempore, etiam dum Missam frequentabat et in cathedralis oratione orabat, cogitationibus suis absorptus erat.

source: When it was almost over, he quickly praised the Sun and wished his sister would always be healthy and that he wouldn’t need much homework or test prep to get into university.
target: Cum paene finivit, celeriter Solem laudavit et optavit ut soror eius semper sana esset et ne multa opera domestica vel praeparationes examinum ad universitatis admissionem necessaria essent.

source: None of that came true.
target: Nihil ex his verum factum est.

source: After the padre finished preaching, Lumian raised his head and narrowed his eyes in the sunlight, focusing on observing the padre’s fortune.
target: Postquam padre praedicationem finivit, Lumian caput attollit et oculos in sole angustiavit, intendens fortunam patris contemplari.

source: There was nothing special about it.
target: Nihil illud praecipuum erat.

source: On the surface, there’s indeed nothing abnormal about Tizamo… Amidst sunburn-like pain, Lumian planned to avert his gaze, but his heart stirred as he activated his Reaper’s Weakness Investigation ability.
target: In superficie, vere nihil abnormale de Tizamo erat… Inter dolorem quasi ustionis, Lumian consilium cepit oculos avertendi, sed cor eius movit cum facultatem Indagationis Infirmitatum Messoris activavit.

source: He thought of Padre Guillaume Bénet and Father Montserrat of the Church of Earth Mother.
target: Cogitavit de Padre Guillaume Bénet et Patre Montserrat Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

source: Who said clergymen from orthodox Churches wouldn’t be problematic?
target: Quis dixit clericos ex Ecclesiis orthodoxis non problematica fore?

source: In that case, he could observe the padre’s weaknesses in advance.
target: Ergo poterat infirmitates patris praevidere.

source: If he truly encountered clerical depravity in the future, he could quickly resolve it.
target: Si clericalem pravitatem in futuro vere occurreret, celeriter eam solvere posset.

source: Various colors appeared on the padre’s body in Lumian’s eyes.
target: Varii colores in corpore patris in oculis Lumiani apparuerunt.

source: However, there was no pale‑white among them!
target: Attamen, inter eos nihil candidum pallidum erat!

source: This meant the padre had no weaknesses!
target: Id significabat patrem nullas infirmitates habere!

source: Impossible.
target: Impossibile.

source: Even if this padre is a Beyonder, his Sequence shouldn’t be too high.
target: Etiamsi hic pater Beyonder sit, ordo eius non debet esse nimis altus.

source: How can he have no weaknesses?
target: Quomodo potest nullas infirmitates habere?

source: The Sun pathway isn’t known for toughness and imperviousness…
target: Iter Solis non notum est ob fortitudinem et inpenetrabilitatem…

source: Could he be from another pathway?
target: Numquid ex alia via provenire potest?

source: No, all likely have weaknesses…
target: Non, omnes verisimiliter infirmitates habent…

source: Amidst surprise, Lumian observed more closely.
target: Inter stuporem, Lumian propius observavit.

source: Finally, he noticed a faint pallor.
target: Denique levem pallorem animadvertit.

source: It wasn’t on the padre’s body, but in the depths of his Astral Projection.
target: Non in corpore patris, sed in profundis eius projectionis astralis erat.

source: Does this mean his weakness lies in his spirit, fearing attacks targeting his Spirit Body?
target: Num hoc significat infirmitatem eius in spiritu esse, metuens impetus in corpus spiritale suum?

source: How did he manage to have no bodily weaknesses… From the looks of it, I have to dismantle his body piece by piece to kill him if I’m not targeting his Spirit Body…
target: Quomodo potuit nullas infirmitates corporales habere… Ex specie, mihi opus est corpus eius singillatim dissolvere ut eum occidam, nisi corpus spiritale eius intuear.

source: Lumian’s surprise quickly dissipated, replaced by joy and anticipation.
target: Stupor Lumiani celeriter evanuit, gaudio et exspectatione substitutus.

source: Regardless, discovering any abnormalities was a good thing!
target: Attamen, abnormitates detegere bonum erat!

source: This meant he was a step closer to the problem in Tizamo and the Dream Festival Hisoka had mentioned.
target: Id significabat eum uno gradu propius esse ad quaestionem in Tizamo et ad Festival Somniorum, quod Hisoka memoraverat.

source: “Brother, what are you looking at?” Cali asked Lumian with a smile, clutching a Bible.
target: “Frater, quid aspicis?” inquit Cali, sub risu, Bibliam tenens, ad Lumian.

source: Lumian responded with a smile, “Looking at the sunlight on you.
target: Lumian risu respondit: “Solem in te fulgentem aspicio.

source: “Praise the Sun!”
target: “Lauda Solem!”

source: With that, Lumian stood up, spread his arms slightly, and turned to leave.
target: Hoc facto, Lumian surrexit, brachia leviter extendit, et se vertit ut abiret.

source: Now was not the time to delve into the abnormality in the padre’s body.
target: Nunc non tempus erat in abnormitatem corporis patris penetrare.

source: Padre Cali was delighted by Lumian’s response.
target: Padre Cali responsu Lumiani delectatus est.

source: Firstly, the other party was subtly praising him for being bathed in sunlight, akin to a deity’s blessings.
target: Primum, ille subtiliter eum laudabat quod sub luce solari infusus esset, quasi benedictionibus deorum.

source: Secondly, as a local clergyman without Northern blood, he had always yearned for Northern gentry’s recognition.
target: Secundo, ut clericus localis sine sanguine septentrionali, semper agnitionem gentis septentrionalis desideraverat.

source: After leaving the Saint-Sien Cathedral, Lumian casually had Camus circle the entirety of Tizamo twice with him, including the military camp, plantation, and the outskirts of the primitive forest.
target: Postquam Cathedralem Sancti-Sien reliquit, Lumian Camum casualiter iussit ut totum Tizamo bis circumambularetur, includens castra militaria, plantationem, et terminos silvae primitivae.

source: Camus eagerly introduced everyone he knew.
target: Camus cunctos quos noverat avidē introduxit.

source: As evening approached, Lumian made his way towards the Brieu Motel and asked, “What did you do with that dead horse?”
target: Cum vesper appropinquabat, Lumian processit ad Brieu Motel et rogavit: “Quid fecisti cum illo equo mortuo?”

source: “I sold it to the butcher. I’m planning to buy a new one from a nearby planter,” Camus replied matter‑of‑factly.
target: “Illum vendidi ad macellarium. Novi emere a plantatore proximo constitutus sum,” Camus respondit.

source: Lumian felt a twinge of disappointment for Ludwig.
target: Lumian paulum maerorem pro Ludwigo sensit.

source: He remained silent and entered the motel.
target: Silens mansit et in motel intravit.

source: Late at night.
target: Sero in nocte.

source: In the shadows outside the Brieu Motel, Lumian emerged, no longer wearing his golden straw hat.
target: In umbris extra Brieu Motel, Lumian apparuit, non iam galeam stramineam auream gerens.

source: He strolled towards the yellowish‑brown house that “Hisoka” Twanaku had rebuilt.
target: Ambulavit versus domum flavobruneam quam “Hisoka” Twanaku restituerat.

source: It was nearly midnight, and Tizamo had grown very quiet.
target: Fere media nox erat, et Tizamo valde quietum factum erat.

source: Apart from a few patrolling soldiers, drunk patrons, and their companions, no one else was walking outside.
target: Praeter paucos milites errantes, clientes ebrios, et socios eorum, nemo alius extra ambulabat.

source: Under the crimson moonlight, Lumian passed by the bar named Giant Boa and heard a commotion inside.
target: Sub luce rubro lunari, Lumian praeteriit tabernae, quae “Giant Boa” appellabatur, et intus strepitum audivit.

source: In the primitive forest a few hundred meters away, the howls of wild beasts echoed intermittently.
target: In silva primitiva, pauca centena passuum procul, ululatus bestiarum ferarum intermittenter resonabant.

source: Lumian proceeded until he reached his destination.
target: Lumian processit donec ad destinatum pervenit.

source: He ascended to the third level and found the wooden bed he had slept on earlier.
target: Ascendit ad tertium gradum et invenit lectum ligneum in quo ante dormiverat.

source: He busied himself for a while, making preparations.
target: Se occupavit per aliquod tempus, praeparationes faciens.

source: He wasn’t in a hurry to lie down.
target: Non festinabat se iacere.

source: He looked around and muttered to himself thoughtfully, “Termiboros, have you noticed anything unusual here?”
target: Circumspiciens et meditabundus, submurmuravit: “Termiboros, quid hic insolitum animadvertisti?”

source: Termiboros’s majestic voice reverberated within Lumian’s body.
target: Vox augustissima Termibori resonabat intra corpus Lumiani.

source: “I’m using your eyes, ears, nose, spirituality, and fate to observe the outside world—just slightly more than what you see.”
target: “Utendo oculis, auribus, naso, spiritualitate, et facto tuo, mundum exterum contemplor—paulo plus quam tu vides.”

source: Does this mean that what I see and discover will still be restricted by my body, spirituality, and level?
target: Num hoc significat quod ea, quae video et detego, adhuc a corpore, spiritualitate, et gradu meo restricta erunt?

source: Hold on, this fellow is becoming more and more like a riddler.
target: Attende, hic vir paulatim magis et magis aenigmaticus fit.

source: He didn’t directly answer if there’s anything abnormal about this house or what’s abnormal… Lumian scoffed.
target: Non directe respondit utrum quid anomale in hac domo esset, et Lumian deridens respondit.

source: “Are you truly an Angel of the Fate domain? I’m already a Sequence 5, and you can’t use my eyes and spirituality to detect the problem here.
target: “Esne vere Angelus Dominii Fati? Ego iam Sequens V sum, et non potes oculos meos atque spiritualitatem meam ad hanc quaestionem detegendam adhibere.

source: Haven’t you noticed that a Sequence 8 of the Monster pathway can sense that this place is cold?
target: Numne animadvertisti Sequens VIII viae Monstrorum hunc locum frigidum esse posse?”

source: No way.
target: Minime.

source: Are Angels of the Inevitability pathway inferior to Sequence 8s of the Fate pathway?
target: Num Angelos viae Inevitabilitatis inferiores putas quam Sequentes VIII viae Fati?

source: The Monster pathway was also known as the Fate pathway.
target: Via Monstrorum etiam appellabatur via Fati.

source: Lumian provoked Termiboros to see if he could extract any useful information from this Angel‑level Ascetic.
target: Lumian Termiborem provocavit ut videat an ex hoc ascetico angelico aliqua utilia notitia extrahere possit.

source: He didn’t hold out much hope, but at least he wouldn’t lose anything.
target: Non multam spem habebat, sed saltem nihil amitteret.

source: Termiboros fell silent, as if He had vanished from Lumian’s body.
target: Termiboros silevit, quasi ex corpore Lumiani evanuerit.

source: “How tolerant. As expected of an Ascetic Angel,” Lumian mocked.
target: “Quam tolerantem! Ut ex ascetico Angelo exspectabatur,” Lumian deridens inquit.

source: He took out the golden pocket watch he had obtained from Salle de Bal Brise and flipped it open to confirm the current time.
target: Egestim aureum horologium, quod ex Salle de Bal Brise adeptus erat, extraxit atque aperuit ut tempus currentem comprobarit.
Hora undecima et quinquaginta unus post meridiem.

source: Putting away his pocket watch, Lumian lay on the wooden bed in the room.
target: Horologium suum reponens, Lumian in lecto ligneo in conclavi iacuit.

source: This time, he was here to see if sleeping in the house at night would trigger any abnormalities and if he could enter a special dream to participate in the Dream Festival.
target: Hoc tempore, hic aderat ut videret si dormitum in domo noctu ullam abnormitatem excitasset et si in somnium speciale intrare posset ad Festival Somniorum participantem.

source: To this end, Lumian had instructed Ludwig in advance to wake him up in the house rebuilt by Twanaku if he wasn’t back by the time they had their second meal.
target: Ad hoc finem, Lumian Ludwigo antea praecepit ut eum excitaret in domo a Twanaku restituta, si non rediret ante tempus secundae mensae.

source: After Lumian promised there would be a feast the next day, Ludwig agreed.
target: Postquam Lumian promisit diem sequentem convivium futurum esse, Ludwig consensit.

source: With crackling sounds, the menacing spiders crawling on the outer walls of the house and the numerous mosquitoes in the room burned and fell, emitting a charred fragrance.
target: Cum sonis crepitantibus, araneae minaces quae in parietibus exterioribus domus reperebant et numerosae culices in conclavi, combustae sunt et ceciderunt, fragrantiam carbonis emittentes.

source: Relying on Cogitation, Lumian swiftly drifted into a deep slumber.
target: Cogitationi innixus, Lumian celeriter in profundum somnum incidit.

source: In a daze, he slowly woke up.
target: Stupore affectus, lente evigilavit.

source: He straightened up and realized that he was still on the wooden bed, in the master bedroom on the third floor of Hisoka’s house.
target: Se rectificavit et animadvertit se adhuc in lecto ligneo, in conclavi principali tertii tabulati domus Hisoka.

source: It was late at night outside the window, and the crimson moonlight seemed to be obscured by clouds.
target: Extra fenestram, nocte sero erat, et rubrum lumen lunae nubibus obtectum videbatur.

source: Only a small amount of light filtered through, making it abnormally dim.
target: Solum parva quantitas luminis pertransibat, quae insolite obscurum faciebat.

source: The howling of wild beasts in the primitive forest and the faint noise from the bar had completely ceased.
target: Ululatus bestiarum ferarum in silva primitiva atque tenuis strepitus ex taberna penitus cessaverunt.

source: The night had entered its most peaceful state, as silent as death.
target: Nox in statum suum quietissimum intravit, tam silens quam mors.

source: There’s no change… Lumian sighed in disappointment.
target: Nulla mutatio erat… Lumian displicenter suspiravit.

source: Just as he was about to take out his golden pocket watch to confirm the time and leave the house in the dark environment to return to the Brieu Motel, his pupils suddenly dilated and his eyes froze.
target: Iam ut horologium aureum suum extraheret, ut tempus comprobarit atque domum in obscuro relinqueret ad Brieu Motel redeundum, pupillae eius subito dilatarentur et oculi eius steterunt.

source: Under the dim crimson moonlight, Lumian swiftly scanned the room’s floor.
target: Sub luce rubra tenui lunae, Lumian celeriter solum conclavis perspexit.

source: He didn’t see mosquito corpses!
target: Non vidit cadavera culicum!

source: The mosquitoes he had incinerated with his Pyromaniac powers before falling asleep should have been charred on the ground, but now, they were nowhere to be found.
target: Culices, quas viribus pyromaniacis ante obdormitum cremaverat, in terra combusta esse debuerunt, sed nunc nusquam reperiebantur.

source: The floor was clean as if it had just been cleaned!
target: Solum plane purum erat, quasi modo nuper purgatum esset!

source: Could it be that someone came in while I was asleep and cleaned the room?
target: Numquid aliquis intravit, dum obdormirem, et conclavum purgavit?

source: I’ve planted several traps around me.
target: Circum me nonnullas insidias posui.

source: They can’t be easily bypassed… Wraith?
target: Eas facile praeterire nemo potest… Wraith?

source: Lumian instantly tensed up.
target: Lumian statim tensus est.

source: He took out the golden pocket watch he had previously kept in his shirt pocket under his vest and flipped it open to check the time.
target: Egestim aureum horologium, quod antea in sinu tunicae sub vestimento servaverat, extraxit atque aperuit ut tempus currentem comprobarit.
Hora undecima et quinquaginta octo post meridiem.
